details: VELDO-0076 detail: install/assets: .veldo/control_project.py installed by the scaffold; .veldo/control_project.py engine copy identical; .veldo/control_project.py laid by the installer

VELDO-0076 detail: project/activation-fields: the service binds exactly the specification's fields; each omitted field refuses by its name; the complete signed activation is accepted; it creates one ACTIVE project of the owner; every field is bound as signed; the charter digest and revision are kept; the history holds the one activation edge; another process reads the same active project

VELDO-0076 detail: project/activation-authority: no-role refuses not_authorized:role; other-scope refuses not_authorized:scope; revoked refuses not_authorized:membership_revoked; forged-signature refuses not_authorized; owner-not-signer refuses not_owner; service refuses not_authorized:not_a_person; policy-unheld refuses inapplicable_policy:security/security_authority; policy-empty refuses invalid_input:authority_policy; policy-unknown-role refuses invalid_input:authority_policy; charter-empty refuses invalid_input:charter; other-repository refuses invalid_input:execution_repository

VELDO-0076 detail: project/unbounded-budget: none budget refuses unbounded_budget; empty budget refuses unbounded_budget; missing-capacity budget refuses unbounded_budget; missing-wall-seconds budget refuses unbounded_budget; infinite budget refuses unbounded_budget; not-a-number budget refuses unbounded_budget; unset-cap budget refuses unbounded_budget; negative budget refuses unbounded_budget; zero budget refuses unbounded_budget; boolean budget refuses unbounded_budget; text budget refuses unbounded_budget; unknown-unit budget refuses unbounded_budget; control: a finite budget activates
VELDO-0076 detail: project/one-active: a second activation refuses already_exists; it writes nothing; exactly one record of the project; no other command writes a project record
VELDO-0076 detail: project/paused-frontier: before the pause both projects' units are offered; the pause is accepted; it names why; control: the other project's unit is still offered

VELDO-0076 detail: project/paused-dispatch: a new dispatch of the paused project is refused by name; a contract prepared before the pause does not launch; control: the running dispatch had launched before the pause

VELDO-0076 detail: project/stop-policy: the pause names the running dispatch it stops; the host's ordinary stop was asked of it; the receiver stopped it as a requested stop; its record ends exited under the same dispatch; the worker process is gone; its worker slot is returned as cancelled
VELDO-0076 detail: project/history-preserved: the pause wrote only the project record; the project history keeps its activation and appends the pause
VELDO-0076 detail: project/resume: the owner resumes the paused project; its unit is offered again; and its work dispatches again

VELDO-0076 detail: project/cancel: a cancel without a reason, by another person or at a stale version is refused and writes nothing; the owner cancels with a recorded disposition; the running dispatch is stopped by the host policy; the frontier offers nothing from it; no dispatch starts from it; cancellation is terminal; the history keeps every earlier entry; another process reads the canceled project
VELDO-0076 detail: project/open-objective: control: the project is active; completion with a pending objective is refused by name; it names exactly that objective; the project is unchanged
VELDO-0076 detail: project/open-assignment: completion with an open assignment is refused by name; it names exactly that assignment
VELDO-0076 detail: project/open-decision: completion with an unsettled governing decision is refused by name; it names exactly that decision on its unit

VELDO-0076 detail: project/open-dispatch: control: the dispatch is prepared and has not launched; completion with an open dispatch is refused by name; it names that dispatch and the worker slot it holds
VELDO-0076 detail: project/open-reservation: control: the dispatch ended and returned its slot; completion with an open reservation is refused by name; it names exactly that worker slot

VELDO-0076 detail: project/complete-resolved: every refused completion left the project at its activation version; with every obligation resolved completion is accepted; its history keeps the activation and appends the completion; the bound charter, budget and policy are preserved; completion is terminal; another process reads the completed project
VELDO-0076 detail: project/observability: every command is observed once; each carries operation, domain, repository, project, request and accepted versions; the metrics count the projects by state
